facts.fact: The Prime Minister's foreword speaks of being 'associated with the launch of the Digital Mauritius 2030 Strategic Plan', which the Ministry of Technology, Communication and Innovation 'has formulated' in consultation with industry; no cabinet or other adopting act is named.
The plan's text is published on the MDPA site; the only horizon it states is 2030 in its title and in the 'Vision 2030' it follows. Date is the document's published date.
